_comment: Copy to outfits.json. One entry per look. 'refs' names photos in refs/cutouts/ (without .jpg): the real items, one photo each. 'clothes' is a list of what changes; describe the same cut as the base outfit if you want the baked texture to line up (README, Outfits).

linen-set.refs_front: Image 2 is a photo of the real shirt (white, short sleeves), image 3 the real shorts.
linen-set.refs_other: Image 3 is a photo of the real shorts.
linen-set.clothes:
- Top: the base t-shirt becomes a plain white cotton crew-neck t-shirt with the same short sleeves, same fit and sleeve length; no print.
- Shorts: relaxed sand-coloured linen shorts with a drawstring elastic waist, ending just above the knee, the same length as the current shorts.
